historical_record.description: The house at 2877 Turk Boulevard was a San Francisco Boys Home group home with six boys, in operation for about two and a half months, in the University Terrace neighbourhood opposite Lone Mountain College. The City Planning Commission unanimously approved, with conditions, raising the San Francisco Boys Home facility at 2877 Turk Boulevard from six to eight residents in an R-2 district, over neighbourhood opposition.
By 1 August 1974, the Board of Supervisors had sustained, by a 9-2 vote, the City Planning Commission's approval of a board and care home.
